Command.Name: StoreEJByCUInvoiceNum
Command.FPOperation: Store Electronic Journal Report by CU Invoice Number (Multiple invoices) to External SD card.

Arg.Name: OptionReportStorage

Option.Name: Storage in External SD card memory
Storage in External SD card memory for JSON

Arg.Desc: 2 symbols for destination: - 'J4' - Storage in External SD card memory - 'JX' - Storage in External SD card memory for JSON

Arg.Name: OptionInvoiceReportFormat
Arg.Desc: 1 character with value - 'N' - Detailed EJ - 'n' - Brief EJ

Arg.Name: StartCUInvoiceNum
Arg.Desc: 10 symbols for start CU invoice number in format: ##########.

Arg.Name: EndCUInvoiceNum
Arg.Desc: 10 symbols for end CU invoice number in format: ##########.
